instruction: Use FEniCS from the command line to design a conductive network. Read /home/user/Desktop/problem_spec.json for the domain, design grid, solver mesh, electrode locations, voltages, keepout cells, material conductivities, and conductive material budget. Read /home/user/Desktop/baseline_conductive_mask.csv as the initial feasible conductive mask. You may use /home/user/Desktop/conductive_network_opt_base.py as the starter workflow. Create /home/user/Desktop/conductive_mask.csv, /home/user/Desktop/solve_submission.py, and /home/user/Desktop/potential.xdmf; if the XDMF writer creates a companion .h5 file, keep it in the same directory. The mask CSV must be 20 by 20, all values must be in [0, 1], the conductive material budget must not exceed 0.25 of the design cells, the keepout cells must remain empty, and the two electrodes must stay connected through conductive cells. Keep the domain, electrode locations, voltages, keepout region, material constants, and material budget from the problem specification unchanged.
